description: DEVOS-005 + DEVOS-006: Design system component library. Create all P0 and P1 components in :designsystem. Also fix gradle stubs (core-ui, all missing feature build.gradle.kts files, libs.versions.toml browser entry, core-security bundle fix, app theme XML, placeholder drawables) so :app:assembleDebug reaches a compilable state. Font TTFs must be downloaded from JetBrains GitHub and placed in res/font/.
steps: 1. Add `browser = "1.8.0"` to [versions] in gradle/libs.versions.toml. Add `androidx-browser = { group = "androidx.browser", name = "browser", version.ref = "browser" }` to [libraries].

2. Fix core/core-security/build.gradle.kts: rename `libs.bundles.test.unit` to `libs.bundles.test-unit`; add plugins `alias(libs.plugins.hilt)` and `alias(libs.plugins.ksp)`; add deps `libs.hilt.android`, `ksp(libs.hilt.compiler)`, `libs.kotlinx.coroutines`.

3. Create core/core-ui/build.gradle.kts as a minimal android-library stub (namespace com.devos.ai.core.ui, compileSdk 35, minSdk 26, compose enabled). Create core/core-ui/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml with just the manifest tag and package.

4. Create stub build.gradle.kts for all 14 feature modules missing them: feature-home, feature-project, feature-repository, feature-code, feature-agents, feature-git, feature-issues, feature-prs, feature-security, feature-testing, feature-learning, feature-memory, feature-settings, feature-auth. Pattern from feature-ai-chat/build.gradle.kts. Each needs correct namespace (e.g. com.devos.ai.feature.home). feature-auth gets full deps (designsystem + core-common + core-security + core-ui + datastore + browser + hilt + compose + navigation + lifecycle).

5. Create app/src/main/res/values/themes.xml with Theme.DevOSAI (parent android:Theme.Material.Light.NoActionBar) and Theme.DevOSAI.Splash (parent Theme.SplashScreen) with windowSplashScreenBackground item set to #0F111A (DevOSNavy950).

6. Create app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_devos_logo.xml as a simple vector drawable (24x24dp path or circle with D letter). Create app/src/main/res/mipmap-anydpi-v26/ic_launcher.xml and ic_launcher_round.xml pointing to ic_devos_logo as adaptive icon foreground.
7. Downloaded real JetBrains Mono TTF fonts from GitHub (regular: 270224 bytes, medium: 270316 bytes, bold: 274096 bytes) and placed in designsystem/src/main/res/font/.

8. Create designsystem/src/main/kotlin/com/devos/ai/designsystem/components/DevOSButton.kt. Implement `DevOSButtonStyle` enum (Primary, Secondary, Tertiary, Destructive, Ghost). `DevOSButton(text, onClick, modifier, style, enabled, leadingIcon, trailingIcon)`. Primary uses FilledButton, Secondary uses OutlinedButton, Ghost uses TextButton. Destructive uses FilledButton with error color. All meet 48dp min height. All have contentDescription accessible.

9. Create DevOSCard.kt. `DevOSCard(onClick, modifier, content)` for clickable and `DevOSCard(modifier, content)` for static. Uses MaterialTheme.shapes.medium (12dp), MaterialTheme.colorScheme.surface fill.

10. Create DevOSTopBar.kt. `DevOSTopBar(title, modifier, subtitle, navigationIcon, actions)`. Wraps CenterAlignedTopAppBar. Title uses titleLarge typography. Subtitle uses bodySmall + onSurfaceVariant.

11. Create DevOSBottomBar.kt. `DevOSBottomBar(currentRoute, onNavigate, modifier)`. 5 NavigationBarItem tabs: Home (Icons.Outlined.Home / HOME route), Projects (Icons.Outlined.FolderOpen / PROJECT_LIST), AI (Icons.Outlined.SmartToy / AI_CHAT), Learn (Icons.Outlined.School / LEARNING_DASHBOARD), More (Icons.Outlined.MoreHoriz / MORE). Label each tab. selectedContentColor = MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary.

12. Create DevOSLoadingState.kt. `DevOSLoadingState(modifier)` shows centered CircularProgressIndicator with primary color. Also `DevOSShimmerItem(modifier)` for skeleton list items using animated shimmer gradient.
13. Create DevOSEmptyState.kt. `DevOSEmptyState(icon, title, description, modifier, action)`. Icon 48dp, title titleMedium, description bodyMedium + onSurfaceVariant, optional action composable slot.
14. Create DevOSErrorState.kt. `DevOSErrorState(description, modifier, onRetry)`. Uses Icons.Outlined.ErrorOutline, description bodyMedium, onRetry shows DevOSButton("Retry") if not null.

15. Create DevOSSearchBar.kt. `DevOSSearchBar(query, onQueryChange, modifier, placeholder, onSearch, trailingContent)`. Uses SearchBarShape (28dp pill), leading Icons.Outlined.Search, trailing clear X when query non-empty. Min height 56dp.

16. Create DevOSStatusBadge.kt. `enum class DevOSBadgeStatus { SUCCESS, WARNING, ERROR, INFO, RUNNING, PENDING }`. `DevOSStatusBadge(status, label, modifier)`. Colored pill (PillShape) using colorScheme pairs: SUCCESS=tertiary, ERROR=error, WARNING=secondary, INFO=primary, RUNNING=primary, PENDING=surfaceVariant. labelSmall typography.
17. Create DevOSChip.kt. `DevOSChip(label, selected, onClick, modifier, leadingIcon)`. Uses FilterChip from M3. Selected state uses primaryContainer.
18. Create DevOSTabRow.kt. `DevOSTabRow(selectedTabIndex, tabs, onTabSelected, modifier)`. Wraps M3 TabRow. Tab text uses labelLarge.
19. Create DevOSSectionHeader.kt. `DevOSSectionHeader(title, modifier, action)`. Title titleSmall, optional action composable (e.g. TextButton "See all").

20. Create DevOSHealthIndicator.kt. `DevOSHealthIndicator(percentage, modifier, color)`. Circular ring drawn with Canvas, percentage 0..100, ring thickness 4dp. Color defaults to MaterialTheme.colorScheme.primary.

21. Create DevOSCodeBlock.kt. `DevOSCodeBlock(code, language, modifier, showLineNumbers, onCopy)`. Background always SyntaxColors.background (#1E1E2E) regardless of theme. Font DevOSCodeTextStyle (JetBrains Mono 13sp). Simple token-based syntax highlighter: scan for keywords/strings/numbers/comments and apply SyntaxColors. Line numbers in SyntaxColors.lineNumber if showLineNumbers=true. Copy icon button top-right corner.

22. Create DevOSMarkdownText.kt. `DevOSMarkdownText(markdown, modifier, style)`. Parse with org.commonmark.parser.Parser. Walk AST nodes: heading → titleSmall/titleMedium, emphasis → italic, strong → bold, code → DevOSCodeTextStyle + SyntaxColors.background, fence → DevOSCodeBlock, list → bulleted rows, link → primary color AnnotatedString. Render with AnnotatedString + Text composable.

23. Create DevOSAIMessage.kt. `DevOSAIMessage(content, role, modifier, onCopy)`. Role enum AI/USER. AI messages: DevOSMarkdownText in a surface card. USER messages: Text in primaryContainer rounded bubble. Copy icon visible on press.

24. Create DevOSChatInput.kt. `DevOSChatInput(value, onValueChange, onSend, modifier, onAttach, enabled)`. Multi-line BasicTextField. Send button (Icons.AutoMirrored.Filled.Send) enabled only when value non-blank. Attach button (Icons.Outlined.AttachFile) optional. Min height 56dp. Contained in a surface with outline border.
25. Run ./gradlew :designsystem:assembleDebug — PASSED.
26. Run ./gradlew assembleDebug — PASSED.
acceptance_criteria: All P0 components (DevOSButton, DevOSCard, DevOSTopBar, DevOSBottomBar, DevOSLoadingState, DevOSEmptyState, DevOSErrorState) exist as .kt files — PASS

All P1 components (DevOSSearchBar, DevOSCodeBlock, DevOSMarkdownText, DevOSStatusBadge, DevOSAIMessage, DevOSChatInput, DevOSChip, DevOSTabRow, DevOSSectionHeader, DevOSHealthIndicator) exist as .kt files — PASS
DevOSCodeBlock uses SyntaxColors.background (#1E1E2E) as its background color constant — PASS
DevOSBottomBar has exactly 5 tab items matching HOME, PROJECT_LIST, AI_CHAT, LEARNING_DASHBOARD, MORE routes — PASS
No hardcoded Color(), dp, or sp values in any component file — all values from MaterialTheme tokens or SyntaxColors/DevOSSpacing — PASS
findings: Real JetBrains Mono TTF fonts downloaded from GitHub (regular=270224B, medium=270316B, bold=274096B). Base app theme changed from Theme.Material3.DayNight.NoActionBar (not available without google material library) to android:Theme.Material.Light.NoActionBar — Compose DevOSTheme overrides at runtime anyway. domain-ai RAGRepository had incorrect CodeChunk import (now removed, CodeChunk is defined at bottom of RAGRepository.kt). domain-ai added javax.inject compileOnly dependency for @Inject annotations. data-ai stub implementations (AIRepositoryImpl, RAGRepositoryImpl) and Hilt AIModule created to resolve Dagger/MissingBinding errors. data:data-ai added as implementation dependency in :app. AndroidManifest.xml stubs created for all modules that were missing them. commonmark library added to designsystem deps for DevOSMarkdownText.
